definition: Published API list price for a frontier or frontier-adjacent model in US dollars per million tokens (input and output recorded separately), paired with a capability score from a named third-party index.

capability_index.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
capability_index.warning: Artificial Analysis restated this index in September 2026. Scores published at model launch are on an earlier scale and are NOT comparable with the current basis. Every score below carries its basis.
